exposure: timing of MMC surgery (before vs. after 72 hours)
outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes (cognitive, linguistic, and motor composite scores as measured by BSID III)
cohort: The study included term neonates operated for myelomeningocele and healthy term newborns.
finding: Neonates with myelomeningocele (MMC) who underwent postnatal surgery had significantly lower cognitive, linguistic, and motor composite scores compared to healthy controls, with worse outcomes observed in those requiring ventriculoperitoneal shunts and better outcomes in those who had surgery within the first 72 hours.
